other_conditions: Applicant must be a student pursuing a Bachelor’s degree from an Agricultural University recognized by ICAR, located outside his/her state of domicile.
Applicant must be admitted into the university through the All India Entrance Examination (AIEE).
The university must be funded under the “Strengthening and Development of Higher Agricultural Education in India” scheme of the Education Division, ICAR.
Applicant must maintain merit and good conduct as certified by the Head of the College/University/Institution.
Applicant must not be absent without prior permission and must not participate in any agitation or strike during the period.
Studies must be taken on a whole‑time basis; the applicant must not take up any job, even part‑time.
Applicant must not accept any other financial assistance or scholarship during the undergraduate study.
Applicant must not leave the course of study within one month of admission.
Applicant must not change the initial subject allocated for which the scholarship was awarded.
benefits_summary: Scholarship of ₹2,000 per month for undergraduate students.
